behavioral_identity: At 32k every frozen opportunity spread episode has exactly one selected TC-014 semantic parent, so adjacency grouping can reorder all selected content without adding, dropping, or duplicating an episode.
design_consequence: Test identity-preserving related-pair grouping, chronology within each group, and explicit earlier/later rendering separately. Do not label natural LoCoMo statements as superseded or current.

name_checks.chronology: LoCoMo adjacent-pair conversation position, not a wall-clock timestamp and not proof of correction
name_checks.group: one selected query-ranked TC-014 parent plus its one selected spread child, if any
name_checks.latest: the greater conversation position inside one group, not automatically the true or current fact
name_checks.supersession: not identifiable because LoCoMo carries no explicit update key or supersedes edge
